title: Anyone have like long term Dream hangovers in waking life.
content: Anyone else ever experience anything like this? This is a very difficult concept to put in words, but I will try. Some of the mallworld dreams have a subconscious ghost image that I realize is with me at times. Thoughts, memories, feelings that come up at certain times and connect directly to mallworld dreamcapes. Some days they can be quite intense. The best thing I kind compare it to is deja-vu, but different.
